query: SELECT U.userID AS `user_id: UserId`, U.username, U.email, UM.metaValue AS `real_name?` FROM users U CROSS JOIN (SELECT ? AS search) S LEFT JOIN users_meta UM ON UM.userID = U.userID AND UM.metaKey = 'profile_realname' LEFT JOIN GDN_User GU ON GU.UserID = U.userID WHERE U.role <> 'deleted' AND COALESCE(GU.Banned, 0) = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oidc_identities OI WHERE OI.userID = U.userID) AND (LOCATE(S.search, U.username) > 0 OR LOCATE(S.search, U.email) > 0 OR LOCATE(S.search, COALESCE(UM.metaValue, '')) > 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN U.username = S.search OR U.email = S.search OR UM.metaValue = S.search THEN 0 WHEN U.username LIKE CONCAT(S.search, '%') OR U.email LIKE CONCAT(S.search, '%') OR UM.metaValue LIKE CONCAT(S.search, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE(NULLIF(UM.metaValue, ''), U.username), U.userID LIMIT ?
